# Themes

### floe's own variables

| Variable | What it changes | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `--floe-inset` | A shadow within | `0 0 #0000` |
| `--face`, `--on-face` | A face | not set |
| `--floe-room` | The space between parts | `0.75rem` |

### Padding and text size

| Variable | What it changes | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `--floe-copy-size` | The copy button | `30px` |

### Part variables

| Variable | Set in | What it changes | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--floe-mark` | The part's file | A mark's size | note `1.6rem`, cards `1.75rem`, timeline `0.7rem` (a card's number, on :scope.numbered) |
| `--floe-mark-gap` | The same | The gap | timeline `0.85rem`, note `0.85rem` |
| `--cards-gap` | `cards.css` | The space in a card | `0.4rem` |
| `--table-head-bg` | `table.css` | A head's background | `var(--quiet)` |
| `--table-rule` | `table.css` | The rule | `1px solid var(--line)` |
| `--tabs-picked-bg`, `--tabs-picked-fg`, `--tabs-picked-ring` | `tabs.css` | The picked tab | `var(--accent-soft)`, `var(--accent)`, `none` |
| `--code-ground` | `code.css` | The copy button's ground | `var(--code-bg)` |
